create_ollama_language_model: create an OllamaLanguageModel instance with a model name and optional system message for local LLM inference
sample_text_from_ollama: sample text completion from a local Ollama model using a prompt with configurable temperature and terminators
sample_choice_from_ollama: sample a multiple choice answer from a local Ollama model by providing a prompt and list of response options
configure_ollama_system_message: configure a custom system message for the OllamaLanguageModel to control sentence continuation behavior
review_ollama_model_class: review the OllamaLanguageModel class that wraps local Ollama LLM models for text generation and choice sampling
